# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: shellShock and stopShellShock on a walking player.
# map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as probe_shock), one client joined allies with the
# m1carbine_mp. Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client about 4 s later:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=30911 PROBE_SECS=45 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_shock mp_carentan
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:30911 --probe-team allies --save-shock --probe-secs 40
# probe_shock.gsc puts the player at (932, -376, -151.875) facing +x at level time 15000
# and shocks it on a schedule; the client half (-shock-client.txt) is the walk it did.
# This file is games_mp.log's PROBE lines: each call with its level time, and the
# player's origin every server frame as `PROBE o <time> <origin>`.
